plugins.name: toolu
plugins.description: Dual-host engineering discipline for Claude Code and Codex: workflow skills, agents, commands, and registry-driven quality hooks.

plugins.name: ast-grep
plugins.description: Structural code search & rewrite (ast-grep): skill, wrapper, and a PreToolUse Grep→ast-grep nudge registered into the toolu hook engine.

plugins.name: comemory
plugins.description: Persistent agent memory + code-index search (comemory): skill, scoped wrapper (with delete/context verbs), a /comemory:setup command that detect-and-guides the binary then wires git index-code hooks, PreToolUse scope enforcement, and a SessionStart memory-count publisher for the statusline — registered into the toolu hook engine.

plugins.name: rust-quality
plugins.description: Rust PostToolUse quality checks registered into the toolu hook engine.

plugins.name: ts-quality
plugins.description: TypeScript PostToolUse quality checks registered into the toolu hook engine.

plugins.name: statusline
plugins.description: Host-native project status: a persistent Claude Code statusline plus an explicit Codex status skill for repository, gate, git, and comemory state. Standalone, no dependencies.

plugins.name: toolu-review
plugins.description: Project-tuned pre-push code review mirroring the CI review bot's checklist (correctness, security, perf, test coverage, doc accuracy), writing the toolu push-review state so the gate passes. Standalone.

plugins.name: pr-babysit
plugins.description: Babysit a PR until review threads, the review-bot verdict, and CI are clear, using Claude cron or a durable Codex goal with isolated worktrees.

plugins.name: agent-browser
plugins.description: Efficient, token-lean browser automation for agents via agent-browser (skill + CLI wrapper) — accessibility-tree snapshots with @eN refs instead of HTML/screenshots. Standalone, no dependencies.

plugins.name: context7
plugins.description: Library documentation & code-example lookup via Context7 (skill + REST wrapper). Standalone, no dependencies.

plugins.name: exa-search
plugins.description: Web, code, and URL search plus deep research via Exa (skill + REST wrapper). Standalone, no dependencies.

plugins.name: jira
plugins.description: Jira issue search and workflow from the session via a REST wrapper (skill + bash). Cloud + Server/DC, read and safe writes. Standalone, no dependencies.

plugins.name: git-better
plugins.description: Token-lean git: a `gb` wrapper with lean defaults plus a cached repo-convention profile, surfaced via PreToolUse nudges registered into the toolu hook engine.
